items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update addressing 11 vulnerabilities, including 5 critical and 5 high severity issues, with the most severe rated CVSS 10.0. These vulnerabilities could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system writes, and security feature bypasses.

items.title: BlockStrap: Template engine injection leading to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-153, is a template engine injection with a CVSS score of 10.0, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Adobe reports no exploitation in the wild for this specific CVE.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency security update to resolve a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Discovered by Sansec, StyleSmuggler is a zero-day vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks started on September 4th, 2026, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7th.

items.title: PolyShell: Unauthenticated unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This vulnerability, with a CVSS score of 9.6, is an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload flaw that could lead to arbitrary code execution. It was addressed in APSB26-73 (July 2026) and has been linked to a JavaScript loader infection campaign affecting numerous online stores.
